declared.title: Maximizers, Satisficers, and Their Satisfaction With and Preferences for Reversible Versus Irreversible Decisions
declared.foundIn: recherche Crossref « reversible irreversible decisions satisfaction replication Gilbert Ebert 2002 » du 2026-11-22 (dossier too-many-choices) ; titre relevé sur Crossref : contrôle d'identité plus faible

population: participants choosing a poster, reversible or final, sorted as maximizers or satisficers (author in the US); sample size not given in the abstract

findings.text: After a final choice of poster, satisficers were more satisfied; maximizers, who search for the best option, were more satisfied when they could reverse it

support.sentence: Study 1 found that satisficers were more satisfied following an irreversible decision about a poster choice, whereas maximizers were more satisfied following a reversible decision.

limits: a poster: a choice of little importance
